title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：restaurant　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 restaurant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the baker ① openned the restaurant that no customer in the bakery would have described, and he said the openning was the whole of the week. The ② restaurant, meaning the eatery itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a restaurant, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ restaurant in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ restaurant at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A restaurant, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the baker said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the restaurant was the whole of the matter, meaning the hospitality and not the eatery. The ⑥ restaurant, meaning the hospitality and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; restaurant, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both an eatery and a hospitality. He said the hospitality is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ restaurant had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ restaurant of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of describing; restaurant, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ restaurant I remember is the eatery described in the bill, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the bakery. A ⑩ restaurant, my mother said in 1970, is the only eatery that improves by being described; every restaurant, she said, is a hospitality that has agreed to look like an eatery. She said the hospitality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 餐馆（指糕饼铺里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 餐馆（指那家餐馆本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the restaurant 开这一家餐馆
D. n. 餐馆（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 餐馆之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的餐馆之事）
F. n. 餐馆（指账单里写到、被描述的那一家）
G. n. 餐馆、待客（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 待客（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the restaurant that no customer in the bakery would have described
The restaurant, meaning the eatery itself and not the tray
the restaurant at the far oven
the restaurant was the whole of the matter
the restaurant had become a line in a bill
The restaurant of the whole thing
A restaurant, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: open the restaurant 意为“开这一家餐馆”，1961 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一家餐馆做了一遍。
restaurant 意为“餐馆”，指那家餐馆本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
restaurant 意为“餐馆”，指糕饼铺里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
restaurant 意为“餐馆”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
restaurant 意为“餐馆、待客”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家待客就是那件事的全部。
restaurant 意为“待客”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家餐馆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
restaurant 意为“餐馆”，指账单里写到、被描述的那一家，到 1966 年这一家成了账单里的一行。
restaurant 意为“餐馆之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的餐馆之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的描述。
restaurant 意为“餐馆”，我记得的是账单里描述过的那一家，1968 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一家。
restaurant 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，餐馆是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的餐馆。
